items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: That's why Herbie Hall has retired to Bourne, Texas. He's living there, but he will take jobs.

ctx.x: That's startling because of the publicity about Nick's. Known all over the world and the guys that played there become --

Salaries were very meager to my knowledge. They never got big. Well, it's surprising when you talk to today and find out that Jimmy Ryan's pays a fat $25 a side man a night? And when you go to buy a drink at Jimmy Ryan's, what does it cost you, $2.75, $2.50? And that's the scale? A six night week gets you a fat -- that's why Herbie Hall has retired to Bourne, Texas. He's living there, but he will take jobs. But he doesn't -- there's nothing there in town.
Yeah, I know, New York is still Scuffle City.
